audit_items.proof_trace: Both directions of the invariant are enforced: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts the asset is not in `debts` before adding it to `ctokens`, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts the asset is not in `ctokens` before adding it to `debts` on the first-borrow path. The only code path that inserts into `debts` is `try_borrow_asset` via `wit_table::add(ObligationDebts{}, ...)`, which is module-private and gated by the collateral check; no alternative insertion path exists.
